info.title: WebExtract API
info.x-guidance: GET /v1/extract?url=<page> returns clean Markdown plus fixed-schema JSON (product/price, tables, article metadata). GET /v1/markdown?url=<page> returns Markdown only and is cheaper. POST with {"url": ...} also works. Pay per call with x402 (USDC on Base (recommended), Polygon, Arbitrum One, World Chain, Monad, Avalanche C-Chain or OP Mainnet) or use a prepaid Bearer key. Without a key, payment or X-Billing: free the API answers 402 (reason x402_required). Free tier: send X-Billing: free (or ?free=1), 20 calls/day per IP. Free test integration: X-Billing: x402-testnet or /sandbox/v1/* (Base Sepolia test USDC only). MCP: POST /mcp (20 free calls/day per IP, no header). JavaScript-heavy pages: GET /v1/render/extract or /v1/render/markdown load the page in a headless browser first (1.6 / 0.8 credits, or $0.008 / $0.004 via x402; free: X-Billing: free, 5 renders/day per IP, separate from the free tier).
info.description: Web page to clean Markdown + fixed-schema structured JSON for AI agents. robots.txt respected. Free tier is opt-in: send X-Billing: free (or ?free=1) for 20 calls/day per IP. Requests with no key, no payment and no opt-in get HTTP 402 Payment Required (reason x402_required); X-Billing: x402 does the same explicitly. MCP (/mcp) keeps 20 free calls/day per IP without a header. Credits never expire. No charge on failed fetches (404, timeout, blocked, robots.txt disallowed). Structured JSON at no extra cost: /v1/extract = 1 credit, /v1/markdown = 0.4 credit. If structured fields come back empty, you're only charged the Markdown rate. Prepaid packs $1=200 credits, $5=1000 credits, $20=5000 credits, $50=15000 credits via https://webextract.dev/#pricing (Authorization: Bearer <key>). Or pay per call without an account via x402 v2: /v1/extract $0.005, /v1/markdown $0.002 in USDC on Base (recommended), Polygon, Arbitrum One, World Chain, Monad, Avalanche C-Chain or OP Mainnet (eip155:8453, eip155:137, eip155:42161, eip155:43114, eip155:10, eip155:480, eip155:143); send the signed payload in the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header; x402 settles at the quoted price and only when the request succeeds. Sandbox for testing x402 clients: same endpoints under /sandbox/v1/* or with X-Billing: x402-testnet, Base Sepolia (eip155:84532) test USDC only, free test money, rate limited. JS rendering (headless browser, JavaScript executed, ports 80/443 only, one render at a time per client): /v1/render/extract = 1.6 credits or $0.008 x402, /v1/render/markdown = 0.8 credits or $0.004 x402; 5 free renders/day per IP with X-Billing: free (separate from the 20/day free tier); sandbox under /sandbox/v1/render/* or X-Billing: x402-testnet. Failed renders are not charged.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Public http(s) URL. Required on GET; on POST it may be sent in the body instead.

parameters.name: X-Billing
parameters.description: free: opt into the free tier (20 calls/day per IP; X-Free-Remaining header); without it, requests with no key and no payment get 402 x402_required. x402: answer 402 with x402 requirements (reason x402_requested). Any other value: 400 invalid_billing_mode. A payment header wins over free; a Bearer key wins over both. x402-testnet: sandbox — same endpoint, but only Base Sepolia test USDC (eip155:84532) is accepted, settled by the x402.org testnet facilitator; free test money only, nothing is charged, rate limited per IP. Equivalent to calling /sandbox/v1/extract or /sandbox/v1/markdown.

parameters.name: free
parameters.description: Same as X-Billing: free (1 or true). Read from the API query string, so URL-encode the target url (curl --data-urlencode) or prefer the header.

200.description: Extraction result (X-Credits-Remaining with a key; X-Free-Remaining only in free mode)

X-Free-Remaining.description: Only in free mode (X-Billing: free or ?free=1)

source.description: Extraction method for the flat fields (not the content source; see content_source)

price_detail.description: Preferred price field. Never contains 0. status=unresolved always comes with unresolved.reason.

type.description: current = the only price shown, no discount information; sale = current price with a higher list price on the page

content_source.description: Where the content came from: raw_html = the HTTP response body, no JavaScript executed (/v1/extract, /v1/markdown); rendered = the page was loaded in a headless browser with JavaScript executed (/v1/render/extract, /v1/render/markdown)

product_unresolved.description: Only when product is null: why no product was extracted (e.g. listing_page)

400.description: Missing or invalid url, forbidden host, or unknown X-Billing value (invalid_billing_mode) (JSON error, not charged)

402.description: Payment required. Body: {error:"payment_required", reason, message, x402, stripe}; reason is one of x402_required (no key, no payment and no free opt-in), x402_requested (X-Billing: x402 sent), free_limit_reached (opted into free with X-Billing: free or ?free=1, daily calls used up; X-Free-Remaining: 0), invalid_payment (payment rejected), unsupported_network, settlement_failed (payment verified but settlement did not complete; not charged; retry with a new payment). Same reason in the X-Payment-Reason header. x402 v2 requirements in the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header. With a Bearer key: {error:"no_credits"}.

X-Free-Remaining.description: Only in free mode (X-Billing: free or ?free=1): 0 when the free quota is used up

422.description: Target site blocked or errored (not charged)

429.description: render_rate_limited: one render at a time per client IP (Retry-After). Not charged. The sandbox also answers 429 rate_limited for its per-IP limit.

502.description: fetch_failed: the browser could not load the page (JSON error, not charged)

503.description: render_busy (all render slots busy), render_failed (render service unavailable or page crashed), shutting_down, render_disabled (rendering switched off on this server). Retry-After on the retryable ones. Not charged.

504.description: render_timeout: the page did not load within the render time limit (15 s per render by default) (JSON error, not charged)
